description: ADR-003a Issue Y broaden-on-exhaustion guard. All three search results have been pitched in prior turns (pitchedHandlesLog contains all returned handles). The dedup filter returns { reason: 'all_results_previously_pitched', cards: [] }. Emma must respond gracefully: acknowledge without blaming the customer, propose a broader angle (different category, broader query, or drop a filter), and not make the customer feel they have broken something or run out of catalog. Must not say 'I cannot find any more results' or use cold/brick-wall language.
priorSummary: Customer has been looking at vibrators. Emma has already shown the Satisfyer Pro 2, We-Vibe Tango X, and Dame Eva II across multiple turns.

searchProducts.message: All matching products have already been shown in this conversation. Try a different search angle: broader query, different category, or drop a filter.

turns.text: show me what else you like

notes: When all search results are in pitchedHandlesLog, runDiscoveryTool returns reason='all_results_previously_pitched'. Emma must NOT say 'I cannot find' or 'catalog exhausted' or anything that implies failure. Acceptable: 'Hmm, I've shown you everything I have at that price point. Want me to widen the search, or try a different direction?' Unacceptable: 'I can't find any more results' or 'the catalog is empty.'
